messages.author: a33d7ba48d4e6d06
messages.subject: recombination rate without physical map
parts:
Dear Professor,

I would like to estimate the rate of recombination in DH mapping population. I do not have a physical map.
 
Is it possible to calculate the rate of recombination?

Thanks,
Yogendra

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] recombination rate without physical map
parts:
What data do you have?

When I think "rate of recombination" I think average number of recombination events per Mbp; for that you'd need some information about physical length.

karl

messages.author: a33d7ba48d4e6d06
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] recombination rate without physical map
parts:
I do have SNP data. 

I can calculate physical length of each chromosome. 

Could you please share an input file to execute est.recrate () function.
 
Thanks,
Yogi

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] recombination rate without physical map
parts:
You can't use est.recrate, because it would require a physical map.

The best you can do is estimate a genetic map and then get average rates for each chromosome, as genetic length / physical length.

karl
